text: The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, shifting between the perspectives of different members of a space expedition team. This narrative structure allows for a multifaceted exploration of the story's events. The tone is dynamic, contrasting the optimistic and curious voice of the scientist with the pragmatic and cautious demeanor of the engineer. Additionally, the language varies in style, utilizing technical terminology when describing machinery and phenomena, while adopting a more reflective and philosophical approach when the characters contemplate their existence and place in the universe.
